column4: Slightly more expensive starter tower. Average fire rate and damage. Reloads one round at a time.
Allows this tower to spot enemies from further away.
Armor piercing rounds allow this tower to deal full damage to armor I enemies.
This tower will have one round (on average) loaded with a heavier round dealing double damage.
Trigger action grip allows the tower to fire faster.
This tower will now unload all 6 rounds at once in quick succession.
